title: gf2-sim batch types + DVB-T2 BICM Stage wrappers
description:
## Goal

Provide the cross-cutting concrete batch types and the DVB-T2 codec/modem
`Stage<I, O>` wrappers that `3fcb7025` (parallel dispatch), `c09d3e95`
(graph API), and `81d05bab` (typestate preset) all build on. Resolves the
Phase A foundation gap: scaffolding (`118a0091`) declared the
`TypedBatch` / `BatchSize` traits but no concrete batch types, and the
DVB-T2 stage wrappers were fragmented into the downstream preset task.

## Context

Task under story `bcf7776d` (CPU foundation) within epic `gf2-sim`
(`f9717e7e`). Created 2026-06-07 by project-lead per a user-approved
escalation ("New shared foundation task"). **Supersedes `81d05bab`
deliverable 2** — the DVB-T2 `Stage` wrappers move here; `81d05bab` now
CONSUMES them rather than defining them. Design SSOT:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §1 (batch types) and §9 (chain).
Wave A.2a: lands after `118a0091`, before the `3fcb7025`/`c09d3e95`
fan-out.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-sim/src/batch.rs` — concrete `BatchSize` + blanket
   `TypedBatch` newtypes per design §1:
   - `BitPackedBatch` — packed info/coded bit frames (`gf2_core::BitVec`).
   - `SymbolBatch` — Gray-QAM IQ symbols (`f32`, SoA per design §2/§10).
   - `LlrBatch` — soft LLRs (`gf2_coding::Llr`).
   - `HardDecisionBatch` — decoded hard-decision bits.
   Each implements the scaffolding `BatchSize` trait (so the blanket
   `TypedBatch` impl applies). Add `pub mod batch;` + re-exports to
   `lib.rs`.

2. `crates/gf2-sim/src/stages/` — new neutral shared module
   (`pub mod stages;` in `lib.rs`). DVB-T2 codec+modem `Stage<I,O>`
   wrappers around the ALREADY-VALIDATED `gf2-coding` types — wrap, do
   NOT reimplement the codec math:
   - `DvbT2Encode`: `BitPackedBatch` (BBFRAME) → `BitPackedBatch`
     (FECFRAME) via `gf2_coding::ldpc::dvb_t2::concat::DvbT2Concat`
     encode (BCH + LDPC).
   - `GrayQamMap`: `BitPackedBatch` → `SymbolBatch` via
     `gf2_coding::modem::GrayQamMapper`.
   - `BitInterleave` / `BitDeinterleave` via
     `gf2_coding::ldpc::dvb_t2::bit_interleaver::DvbT2BitInterleaver`.
   - `GrayQamDemap`: `SymbolBatch` → `LlrBatch` via
     `gf2_coding::modem::FastGrayQamDemapper`.
   - `DvbT2Decode`: `LlrBatch` → `BitPackedBatch` via `DvbT2Concat`
     `decode_soft` (LDPC + BCH).
   All are pure-CPU stages (`type CpuFallback = Self`,
   `ExecutionClass::CpuOnly`). (Verify exact gf2-coding type/method names
   by reading the sources; do not guess APIs.)
   - A `dvb_t2_bicm_stages(rate, modulation, decoder, demap)` factory
     returning the ordered forward+inverse BICM stage list, so
     `c09d3e95` / `81d05bab` / `3fcb7025` reuse one wiring.

3. `tests/dvb_t2_stage_roundtrip.rs` — noiseless forward+inverse roundtrip
   (encode → map → interleave → deinterleave → demap-to-hard → decode)
   reconstructs the input BBFRAME bit-exactly (NO channel) for at least
   r1/2 16-QAM and r1/2 64-QAM. This is the shared ground truth `c09d3e95`
   reuses for its graph correctness test.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `batch.rs` defines the four concrete batch types implementing the
  scaffolding `BatchSize` / `TypedBatch`, reachable as `gf2_sim::batch::*`.
- [hard] The `stages` module provides the DVB-T2 codec+modem `Stage`
  wrappers around the existing validated `DvbT2Concat` / `GrayQamMapper` /
  `FastGrayQamDemapper` / `DvbT2BitInterleaver` — NO reimplementation of
  BCH/LDPC/QAM math.
- [hard] Noiseless forward+inverse roundtrip is bit-exact for ≥ 2 MODCODs
  (r1/2 16-QAM, r1/2 64-QAM).
- [hard] No new `unsafe`; `gf2-sim` stays `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- No channel stages (owned by `db9836e4`). No per-worker parallel dispatch
  / ChaCha20 seek (owned by `3fcb7025`). No graph API (`c09d3e95`). No
  typestate preset (`81d05bab`). No GPU stages (Phase B).
- Do NOT reimplement BCH / LDPC / QAM / interleaver math — wrap the
  existing, bit-exact gf2-coding types.
